_about: Inputs of the SP-106 slosh parameters used by models/slosh/basilisk.py. Basilisk flies the slosh pendulums; it does not compute their parameters. Every number is the one the slosh model uses, with its source.

xi.source: First root of J1'(x) = 0. NASA SP-106 (Abramson, ed., 1966), p. 56; Table 6.1 (p. 204) uses 2 xi = 3.68.

wall_k.source: SP-106 eq. (4.10b), p. 111: smooth-wall damping constant (Stephens et al.).

miles_k.source: SP-106 eq. (4.16), p. 123: Miles' ring-baffle damping.

break_zeta.source: A rule: extra damping ratio once the wave at the wall is taller than the tank radius.

a_settled_m_s2.source: A rule: below this axial acceleration the liquid is not held at the tank bottom and the pendulum is frozen.

dome_height_per_radius.source: vehicle.py: tank domes are half oblate spheroids of height R / sqrt(2).

kinematic_viscosity_m2_s.source: Cryogens: NIST Chemistry WebBook, saturated liquid at the normal boiling point (LOX 194.8 uPa s / 1141.3 kg/m3 at 90.16 K; LH2 13.6 uPa s / 70.95 kg/m3 at 20.27 K; CH4 116.2 uPa s / 422.0 kg/m3 at 111.9 K). RP-1: NISTIR 6646 (2007), Table 11, 298.15 K. MMH 0.78 mPa s and N2O4 0.40 mPa s at 25 C: Martin Marietta MCR-74-27 (NASA CR, NAS9-13709, 1974), Figures 6 and 7.

dome_omega_ratio.source: First slosh frequency of the domed tank over the flat-bottomed cylinder with the same liquid volume, against free-surface height / radius. Linear potential-flow solver, results/issue-62/dome_slosh.json (checked against SP-106's flat cylinder within 0.4% to 0.9%).
